Each metric's pass threshold *T* is a constant pinned in the test module, and it is trusted only after calibration in the same test, per the workspace measurement-validity rule: the **known-good anchor** (the subject rendered outside the LPAC, where the font mapper works normally) must score above *T*, and both **known-garbage anchors** — an all-white page and a box-glyph page synthesized in code from the reference's glyph bounding boxes — must score below it, i.e. `score(good) > T > max(score(garbage))` on each metric before the LPAC render is judged.
